denominator.method: Reconstruct the catalog statement as the first 20 B1 §4.2 known rows (through C11) plus the 13 B2 KNOWN rows. Preserve grouped aliases as rows. Exclude the final six B1 known rows that already appear directly in the 72 extracted matrix: TSV-04, TSV-06, PY-01, PY-02, WV-9, and N-13/N-24/N-25/N-27.
denominator.caveat: PR58 JSON does not provide a standalone 33-element known array. This explicit reconstruction is not a claim of 33 independent additional vulnerabilities. TR-07/TR-08 exactly duplicates a 72-row item and several other rows share mechanisms/components.

status_definitions.fixed: The narrow recorded mechanism is implemented correctly in inspected source, with executed evidence where listed. This is not a blanket security closure; source-only rows and execution limits are explicit.
status_definitions.partial: A component/guard is repaired or coverage improved, but a specific residual or qualification gap remains.
status_definitions.reproducible: Existing independently executed canonical evidence demonstrates the recorded mechanism; candidate-only repairs remain separate.
status_definitions.unverified: Source identifies a retained construction/surface, but fresh impact or complete security qualification is unavailable. Presence is not confused with demonstrated exploit impact.

evidence_policy: Repository sources and historical reports were read only. No product edit or remote mutation was performed.
No new probe output is used in this matrix. Interrupted/withdrawn known-p11-p10 scratch probes are deliberately excluded, per parent instruction.
Crypto/protocol/verifier/Python suite evidence is from PR57 fd23cb3, not a new canonical suite run. Unchanged relevant source or unchanged guard logic is stated where evidence is transferred.
The canonical custody/server log contains 32 executed passing tests. The TR-03 test title is not treated as proof of an actual child-process race.
Existing test source alone is not an execution receipt. BC-01/BC-10/DEP-01 are narrowly source-reviewed fixes with explicit unexecuted runtime qualification.
AI analysis and passing tests do not count as human/security-group approvals.
